annotation.text: This sample maps 136,700 recorded gun-violence incidents across the United States, from January 2013 through March 2018.
Recorded incidents form a denser pattern across much of the eastern United States.
Moving west toward the central interior, recorded incidents appear more dispersed.
California also contains several visible clusters of recorded incidents.
A closer look at Chicago reveals a pronounced concentration of recorded incidents.
Across this sample, 136,700 incidents record 57,178 deaths and 114,535 injuries.
